what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee reached rough consensus, without a formal vote, to demolish the trailer, hold public safety automation and treat DPW roof repair as a yes.
Members marked each department request yes, no or on the bubble, with consensus forming on police items, Turkey Hill asbestos work, the primary phone system and one DPW truck.
The committee agreed to change the primary phone system figure on the schedule to the reduced amount.
Members discussed saving or borrowing toward a fire ladder truck and asked the financial advisor for a debt schedule.
Bubble items, including a second DPW pickup, will be revisited once the building condition assessment arrives.

why_it_matters: These informal rankings shape which capital requests, and how much borrowing or saving for a fire ladder truck, go to Town Meeting, where residents vote and where the costs reach the tax bill.
watch_next: The building condition assessment, after which the committee will look again at the bubble items.
The debt schedule requested from the financial advisor.
